core_obligations: Condition (1) (proof line 3587): fibred in groupoids, by the quot-chapter lemma.
Condition (2) (proof lines 3589-3597): Isom presheaves are sheaves - diagonal lemma for fp,flat,proper, Examples of Stacks pre-stack lemma for finite type.

Condition (3), finite type (proof lines 3599-3615): given the fppf covering with glued objects and cocycle of isomorphisms, the Bootstrap effectivity lemma part (2) produces X, and finite type descends along the covering.
Condition (3), fp,flat,proper (proof lines 3616-3622): additionally finite presentation, flatness, and properness descend along the fppf covering.
proof_roadmap: Handle condition (1) by the fibred-in-groupoids lemma (proof line 3587).
Handle condition (2) via the diagonal in the fp,flat,proper case and the pre-stack lemma in the finite type case (proof lines 3589-3597).
Produce the descended space X by the Bootstrap effectivity lemma and descend finite type (proof lines 3599-3615).
Descend finite presentation, flatness, properness for the fp,flat,proper variant (proof lines 3616-3622).
